opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation; up to two Co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) supporting genuine interdisciplinary research at the boundary between science, engineering and the social sciences and humanities, with up to £10,000 for public engagement.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK meeting the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs; seed funding available for participants' collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', with seed funding available for international collaborations formed at the symposium.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80 per cent of salary, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers ordinarily resident in the UK holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or Independent Research Organisation, intending to pursue original independent research in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in core areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: PI must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% of time on the award; Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: Supports projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences working with international partners on genuinely interdisciplinary projects across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Up to two one-year fellowships hosted in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, allowing researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (exceptional circumstances may exceed this within reason)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months, who meet the eligibility of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, caring costs on research trips, assistance to make applications), reviewed on a rolling case-by-case basis.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom; independent scholars eligible; Co-applicants may be from anywhere but Principal Applicant must be UK-resident.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants (up to £10,000, tenable up to 24 months) to cover the expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences.
